"6c9995c5-1dc2-5c84-888e-84f7f28ad60c" :question/problem "Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by

M=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}.

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+2y &=-4\\ 0x+0y &=0.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

$$
x+2y=-4.
$$

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x &=-2y-4\\ y &=y\end{aligned}\right.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{bmatrix}x \\  y \end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix} -2y-4 \\  y \end{bmatrix}=⟨-2y-4,y⟩,\,y\in (-\infty ,\infty ).\end{aligned}
